BEARISH: Technology (-3.31% 1W; -16.09% 1M), Energy (-1.68%; -11.74%), and Financials (-0.90%; -1.17%) show weakness; overall breadth remains 5/11 sectors positive.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
